claims.sentence: Two field isolates of A. flavus , AF13 and NRRL3357, possessing high and moderate aflatoxin production, respectively, were cultured in medium with and without supplementation with 15mM H 2 O 2 , and mycelia were collected following 4 and 7 days in culture for global metabolomics.
